// This host interface applies to the Linux x86-64 LP64 profile.
record CDriverStat {
    device: u64;
    inode: u64;
    links: u64;
    mode: u32;
    uid: u32;
    gid: u32;
    padding: i32;
    special_device: u64;
    size: i64;
    block_size: i64;
    blocks: i64;
    access_seconds: i64;
    access_nanoseconds: u64;
    modify_seconds: i64;
    modify_nanoseconds: u64;
    change_seconds: i64;
    change_nanoseconds: u64;
    reserved: [i64; 3];
}

extern fn c_driver_lstat(path: *u8, info: *CDriverStat) -> i32 = "lstat";
extern fn c_driver_errno() -> *i32 = "__errno_location";
extern fn c_driver_strerror(number: i32) -> *u8 = "strerror";
extern fn c_driver_mkstemp(path: *u8) -> i32 = "mkstemp";
extern fn c_driver_close(descriptor: i32) -> i32 = "close";
extern fn c_driver_unlink(path: *u8) -> i32 = "unlink";
extern fn c_driver_rename(source: *u8, destination: *u8) -> i32 = "rename";
extern fn c_driver_realpath(path: *u8, resolved: *u8) -> *u8 = "realpath";
extern fn c_driver_fork() -> i32 = "fork";
extern fn c_driver_execvp(file: *u8, arguments: **u8) -> i32 = "execvp";
extern fn c_driver_waitpid(pid: i32, status: *i32, options: i32) -> i32 = "waitpid";
extern fn c_driver_exit(status: i32) -> unit = "_exit";

record CDriverTemp { path: *u8; next: *CDriverTemp; }

// Mode 0 emits an executable, 1 emits an object, and 2 emits C text.
// Native outputs require a file path. Null or "-" selects stdout for C text.
// Symbols is an optional separate response-file path for C text only.
// Keep all option strings and flag arrays live until c_backend_build returns.
record CBackendOptions {
    mode: u32;
    output: *u8;
    symbols: *u8;
    cflags: **u8;
    cflag_count: usize;
    ldflags: **u8;
    ldflag_count: usize;
}

record CDriver {
    stage: *CStage;
    options: *CBackendOptions;
    command: **u8;
    temporary: *CDriverTemp;
    process_status: i32;
}

fn c_driver_buffer(status: *CStatus, result: *CBuffer) -> unit {
    *result = make CBuffer { status: status, data: null(*u8), size: 0usize, capacity: 0usize };
}

fn c_driver_join(status: *CStatus, left: *u8, right: *u8) -> *u8 {
    var buffer: CBuffer = uninit;
    c_driver_buffer(status, &buffer);
    c_buffer_text(&buffer, left);
    c_buffer_text(&buffer, right);
    return c_buffer_end(&buffer);
}

fn c_driver_error(driver: *CDriver, message: *u8) -> bool {
    c_error(&(*(*driver).stage).status, null(*RmdSource), 0usize, message);
    return false;
}

fn c_driver_io_error(driver: *CDriver, action: *u8, path: *u8, number: i32) -> bool {
    var buffer: CBuffer = uninit;
    c_driver_buffer(&(*(*driver).stage).status, &buffer);
    c_buffer_text(&buffer, action);
    if path != null(*u8) {
        c_buffer_text(&buffer, " '");
        c_buffer_text(&buffer, path);
        c_buffer_text(&buffer, "'");
    }
    c_buffer_text(&buffer, ": ");
    c_buffer_text(&buffer, c_driver_strerror(number));
    var message: *u8 = c_buffer_end(&buffer);
    if message != null(*u8) { c_driver_error(driver, message); }
    return false;
}

fn c_driver_temporary(driver: *CDriver, destination: *u8) -> *u8 {
    if destination[0usize] != 47u8 {
        destination = c_driver_join(&(*(*driver).stage).status, "./", destination);
        if destination == null(*u8) { return null(*u8); }
    }
    var path: *u8 = c_driver_join(&(*(*driver).stage).status, destination, ".tmp.XXXXXX");
    var item: *CDriverTemp = c_alloc(&(*(*driver).stage).status, sizeof(CDriverTemp), alignof(CDriverTemp)) as *CDriverTemp;
    if path == null(*u8) || item == null(*CDriverTemp) { return null(*u8); }
    var descriptor: i32 = c_driver_mkstemp(path);
    if descriptor < 0i32 {
        c_driver_io_error(driver, "cannot create temporary for", destination, *c_driver_errno());
        return null(*u8);
    }
    *item = make CDriverTemp { path: path, next: (*driver).temporary };
    (*driver).temporary = item;
    if c_driver_close(descriptor) != 0i32 {
        c_driver_io_error(driver, "cannot close temporary", path, *c_driver_errno());
        return null(*u8);
    }
    return path;
}

fn c_driver_derived(driver: *CDriver, base: *u8, suffix: *u8) -> *u8 {
    var path: *u8 = c_driver_join(&(*(*driver).stage).status, base, suffix);
    if path == null(*u8) { return null(*u8); }
    return c_driver_temporary(driver, path);
}

fn c_driver_cleanup(driver: *CDriver, keep: *u8) -> bool {
    var success: bool = true;
    var item: *CDriverTemp = (*driver).temporary;
    while item != null(*CDriverTemp) {
        if keep == null(*u8) || !c_equal((*item).path, keep) {
            if c_driver_unlink((*item).path) != 0i32 && *c_driver_errno() != 2i32 {
                var prefix: *u8 = "rmd-c: cannot remove temporary '";
                rmd0_host_write_stream(2u32, prefix, c_length(prefix));
                rmd0_host_write_stream(2u32, (*item).path, c_length((*item).path));
                rmd0_host_write_stream(2u32, "'\n", 2usize);
                success = false;
            }
        }
        item = (*item).next;
    }
    return success;
}

// Return 0 for an absent path, 1 for a regular file, and 2 for another file kind.

fn c_driver_output_kind(driver: *CDriver, path: *u8) -> i32 {
    var info: CDriverStat = uninit;
    if c_driver_lstat(path, &info) == 0i32 {
        if (info.mode & 61440u32) == 32768u32 { return 1i32; }
        return 2i32;
    }
    var error: i32 = *c_driver_errno();
    if error == 2i32 { return 0i32; }
    c_driver_io_error(driver, "cannot inspect output", path, error);
    return -1i32;
}

fn c_driver_write(driver: *CDriver, path: *u8, buffer: *CBuffer) -> bool {
    if rmd0_host_write_file(path, (*buffer).data, (*buffer).size) != 0i32 {
        return c_driver_io_error(driver, "cannot write output", path, *c_driver_errno());
    }
    return true;
}

fn c_driver_publish(driver: *CDriver, temporary: *u8, output: *u8) -> bool {
    if c_driver_rename(temporary, output) != 0i32 {
        return c_driver_io_error(driver, "cannot publish output", output, *c_driver_errno());
    }
    return true;
}

fn c_driver_run(driver: *CDriver, count: usize) -> bool {
    (*driver).command[count] = null(*u8);
    var pid: i32 = c_driver_fork();
    if pid < 0i32 {
        return c_driver_io_error(driver, "cannot start", (*driver).command[0usize], *c_driver_errno());
    }
    if pid == 0i32 {
        c_driver_execvp((*driver).command[0usize], (*driver).command);
        var prefix: *u8 = "rmd-c: cannot execute ";
        rmd0_host_write_stream(2u32, prefix, c_length(prefix));
        rmd0_host_write_stream(2u32, (*driver).command[0usize], c_length((*driver).command[0usize]));
        rmd0_host_write_stream(2u32, "\n", 1usize);
        c_driver_exit(127i32);
        trap;
    }
    var status: i32 = 0i32;
    while true {
        var result: i32 = c_driver_waitpid(pid, &status, 0i32);
        if result == pid { break; }
        if result < 0i32 && *c_driver_errno() == 4i32 { continue; }
        return c_driver_io_error(driver, "cannot wait for", (*driver).command[0usize], *c_driver_errno());
    }
    if (status & 127i32) == 0i32 {
        (*driver).process_status = (status >> 8i32) & 255i32;
    } else {
        (*driver).process_status = 128i32 + (status & 127i32);
    }
    if (*driver).process_status == 0i32 { return true; }
    var message: CBuffer = uninit;
    c_driver_buffer(&(*(*driver).stage).status, &message);
    c_buffer_text(&message, (*driver).command[0usize]);
    c_buffer_text(&message, " failed with status ");
    c_buffer_number(&message, (*driver).process_status as u64);
    var text: *u8 = c_buffer_end(&message);
    if text != null(*u8) { c_driver_error(driver, text); }
    return false;
}

fn c_driver_compile(driver: *CDriver) -> bool {
    var kind: i32 = c_driver_output_kind(driver, (*(*driver).options).output);
    if kind < 0i32 { return false; }
    if kind == 2i32 || c_equal((*(*driver).options).output, "-") {
        return c_driver_error(driver, "object and executable outputs require a regular file path");
    }
    var stage: *CStage = (*driver).stage;
    var base: *u8 = c_driver_temporary(driver, (*(*driver).options).output);
    if base == null(*u8) { return false; }
    var source: *u8 = c_driver_derived(driver, base, ".c");
    var response: *u8 = c_driver_derived(driver, base, ".rsp");
    var original: *u8 = c_driver_derived(driver, base, ".input.o");
    var object: *u8 = c_driver_derived(driver, base, ".o");
    var binary: *u8 = c_driver_derived(driver, base, ".bin");
    var response_argument: *u8 = c_driver_join(&(*stage).status, "@", response);
    if (*stage).status.failed { return false; }
    if !c_driver_write(driver, source, &(*stage).header) ||
       !c_driver_write(driver, response, &(*stage).renames) { return false; }
    var arguments: **u8 = (*driver).command;
    arguments[0usize] = "gcc";
    arguments[1usize] = "-std=c99";
    arguments[2usize] = "-pedantic-errors";
    arguments[3usize] = "-O2";
    arguments[4usize] = "-g0";
    arguments[5usize] = "-fstack-clash-protection";
    arguments[6usize] = "-Wno-overlength-strings";
    var count: usize = 7usize;
    var index: usize = 0usize;
    while index < (*(*driver).options).cflag_count {
        arguments[count] = (*(*driver).options).cflags[index];
        count = count + 1usize;
        index = index + 1usize;
    }
    arguments[count] = "-c";
    arguments[count + 1usize] = "-x";
    arguments[count + 2usize] = "c";
    arguments[count + 3usize] = source;
    arguments[count + 4usize] = "-o";
    arguments[count + 5usize] = original;
    if !c_driver_run(driver, count + 6usize) { return false; }
    arguments[0usize] = "objcopy";
    arguments[1usize] = response_argument;
    arguments[2usize] = original;
    arguments[3usize] = object;
    if !c_driver_run(driver, 4usize) { return false; }
    var result: *u8 = object;
    if (*(*driver).options).mode == 0u32 {
        arguments[0usize] = "gcc";
        arguments[1usize] = "-no-pie";
        arguments[2usize] = object;
        count = 3usize;
        index = 0usize;
        while index < (*(*driver).options).ldflag_count {
            arguments[count] = (*(*driver).options).ldflags[index];
            count = count + 1usize;
            index = index + 1usize;
        }
        arguments[count] = "-o";
        arguments[count + 1usize] = binary;
        if !c_driver_run(driver, count + 2usize) { return false; }
        result = binary;
    }
    if !c_driver_cleanup(driver, result) { return c_driver_error(driver, "temporary cleanup failed"); }
    return c_driver_publish(driver, result, (*(*driver).options).output);
}

fn c_driver_dump(driver: *CDriver) -> bool {
    var stage: *CStage = (*driver).stage;
    var output: *u8 = (*(*driver).options).output;
    var symbols: *u8 = (*(*driver).options).symbols;
    var output_temporary: *u8 = null(*u8);
    var symbols_temporary: *u8 = null(*u8);
    var stream_output: bool = output == null(*u8) || c_equal(output, "-");
    if !stream_output {
        var kind: i32 = c_driver_output_kind(driver, output);
        if kind < 0i32 { return false; }
        if kind != 2i32 {
            output_temporary = c_driver_temporary(driver, output);
            if output_temporary == null(*u8) || !c_driver_write(driver, output_temporary, &(*stage).header) { return false; }
        }
    }
    if symbols != null(*u8) {
        var kind: i32 = c_driver_output_kind(driver, symbols);
        if kind < 0i32 { return false; }
        if kind != 2i32 {
            symbols_temporary = c_driver_temporary(driver, symbols);
            if symbols_temporary == null(*u8) || !c_driver_write(driver, symbols_temporary, &(*stage).renames) { return false; }
        }
    }
    if symbols != null(*u8) {
        if symbols_temporary != null(*u8) {
            if !c_driver_publish(driver, symbols_temporary, symbols) { return false; }
        } else {
            if !c_driver_write(driver, symbols, &(*stage).renames) { return false; }
        }
    }
    if stream_output {
        if rmd0_host_write_stream(1u32, (*stage).header.data, (*stage).header.size) != 0i32 {
            return c_driver_io_error(driver, "cannot write standard output", null(*u8), *c_driver_errno());
        }
        return true;
    }
    if output_temporary != null(*u8) { return c_driver_publish(driver, output_temporary, output); }
    return c_driver_write(driver, output, &(*stage).header);
}

fn c_driver_canonical(driver: *CDriver, path: *u8) -> *u8 {
    var status: *CStatus = &(*(*driver).stage).status;
    var resolved: *u8 = c_driver_realpath(path, null(*u8));
    if resolved != null(*u8) {
        var copied: *u8 = c_driver_join(status, resolved, "");
        rmd0_host_free(resolved);
        return copied;
    }
    var error: i32 = *c_driver_errno();
    if error != 2i32 {
        c_driver_io_error(driver, "cannot resolve paired output", path, error);
        return null(*u8);
    }
    var info: CDriverStat = uninit;
    if c_driver_lstat(path, &info) == 0i32 {
        c_driver_error(driver, "paired outputs require resolvable symbolic links");
        return null(*u8);
    }
    error = *c_driver_errno();
    if error != 2i32 {
        c_driver_io_error(driver, "cannot inspect paired output", path, error);
        return null(*u8);
    }
    var size: usize = c_length(path);
    if size == 0usize {
        c_driver_error(driver, "empty output path");
        return null(*u8);
    }
    var split: usize = size;
    while split != 0usize && path[split - 1usize] != 47u8 { split = split - 1usize; }
    var parent: CBuffer = uninit;
    c_driver_buffer(status, &parent);
    if split == 0usize { c_buffer_text(&parent, "."); }
    else { c_buffer_bytes(&parent, path, split); }
    var parent_path: *u8 = c_buffer_end(&parent);
    if (*status).failed { return null(*u8); }
    resolved = c_driver_realpath(parent_path, null(*u8));
    if resolved == null(*u8) {
        c_driver_io_error(driver, "cannot resolve output directory", parent_path, *c_driver_errno());
        return null(*u8);
    }
    var result: CBuffer = uninit;
    c_driver_buffer(status, &result);
    c_buffer_text(&result, resolved);
    if resolved[c_length(resolved) - 1usize] != 47u8 { c_buffer_text(&result, "/"); }
    c_buffer_bytes(&result, &path[split], size - split);
    rmd0_host_free(resolved);
    return c_buffer_end(&result);
}

fn c_driver_validate(driver: *CDriver) -> bool {
    if (*(*driver).options).mode > 2u32 {
        return c_driver_error(driver, "C backend mode must be executable, object, or C text");
    }
    if ((*(*driver).options).cflag_count != 0usize && (*(*driver).options).cflags == null(**u8)) ||
       ((*(*driver).options).ldflag_count != 0usize && (*(*driver).options).ldflags == null(**u8)) {
        return c_driver_error(driver, "C backend flag array is null");
    }
    if (*(*driver).options).mode < 2u32 && (*(*driver).options).output == null(*u8) {
        return c_driver_error(driver, "object and executable modes require -o OUTPUT");
    }
    if (*(*driver).options).symbols != null(*u8) {
        if (*(*driver).options).mode != 2u32 { return c_driver_error(driver, "--symbols requires --emit-c"); }
        if c_equal((*(*driver).options).symbols, "-") ||
           ((*(*driver).options).output != null(*u8) && c_equal((*(*driver).options).symbols, (*(*driver).options).output)) {
            return c_driver_error(driver, "--symbols requires a separate file path");
        }
        if (*(*driver).options).output != null(*u8) && !c_equal((*(*driver).options).output, "-") {
            var output_path: *u8 = c_driver_canonical(driver, (*(*driver).options).output);
            if output_path == null(*u8) { return false; }
            var symbols_path: *u8 = c_driver_canonical(driver, (*(*driver).options).symbols);
            if symbols_path == null(*u8) { return false; }
            if c_equal(output_path, symbols_path) {
                return c_driver_error(driver, "C and symbol outputs must name separate destinations");
            }
            var output_info: CDriverStat = uninit;
            var symbols_info: CDriverStat = uninit;
            var output_exists: bool = c_driver_lstat(output_path, &output_info) == 0i32;
            if !output_exists && *c_driver_errno() != 2i32 {
                return c_driver_io_error(driver, "cannot inspect paired output", output_path, *c_driver_errno());
            }
            var symbols_exist: bool = c_driver_lstat(symbols_path, &symbols_info) == 0i32;
            if !symbols_exist && *c_driver_errno() != 2i32 {
                return c_driver_io_error(driver, "cannot inspect paired output", symbols_path, *c_driver_errno());
            }
            if output_exists && symbols_exist && output_info.device == symbols_info.device &&
               output_info.inode == symbols_info.inode {
                return c_driver_error(driver, "C and symbol outputs must name separate files");
            }
        }
    }
    return true;
}

// Require checked trees, assigned caller-owned link names, and a valid hosted entry or null.
// Keep the context, entry, source storage, and options live for the complete call.
// Retain input trees and names unchanged. Record failures in the caller's context.
// Return 0 on success, a failed tool's status, or 1 for another failure.
fn c_backend_build(context: *RmdContext, entry: *RmdDecl, options: *CBackendOptions) -> i32 {
    var stage: CStage = uninit;
    c_stage_init(&stage, context);
    var driver: CDriver = make CDriver {
        stage: &stage, options: options, command: null(**u8),
        temporary: null(*CDriverTemp), process_status: 0i32
    };
    var success: bool = c_driver_validate(&driver);
    if success { success = c_emit(&stage, entry); }
    if success {
        c_buffer_bytes(&stage.header, stage.body.data, stage.body.size);
        success = !stage.status.failed;
    }
    if success && (*options).mode != 2u32 {
        var capacity: usize = (*options).cflag_count;
        if (*options).ldflag_count > capacity { capacity = (*options).ldflag_count; }
        if capacity > 9223372036854775807usize / sizeof(*u8) - 16usize {
            success = c_driver_error(&driver, "C backend argument array size overflow");
        } else {
            driver.command = c_alloc(&stage.status, (capacity + 16usize) * sizeof(*u8), alignof(*u8)) as **u8;
            success = !stage.status.failed;
        }
    }
    if success {
        if (*options).mode == 2u32 { success = c_driver_dump(&driver); }
        else { success = c_driver_compile(&driver); }
    }
    if !c_driver_cleanup(&driver, null(*u8)) {
        c_driver_error(&driver, "temporary cleanup failed");
        success = false;
    }
    var result: i32 = 0i32;
    if !success {
        result = driver.process_status;
        if result == 0i32 { result = 1i32; }
    }
    c_stage_destroy(&stage);
    return result;
}
